fields.main_text:
Biomed Ingredients Australia is committed towards good health and protection of the environment.

When Bio-Med Ingredients was born in 2014, our mission has been to manufacture and supply organically produced medicinal plants to the nutritional, cosmetic, pharmaceutical and food industries.

We live in an era, where health is not wealth but it is seen as a means of making wealth. Conventional farming is literally killing our well-being and ecology. In order to increase the yield exponentially, harsh and hostile chemicals are introduced into farming. This has not just damaged our soil and water but has introduced a host of new diseases that are affecting both man and animals.
fields.mission_text: To deliver superior natural ingredients that meet global standards, fostering health and sustainability.
fields.vision_text: To be the leading global provider of natural ingredients, driving innovation and responsible sourcing.
fields.values_text: Integrity, Quality, Innovation, Sustainability, Customer Focus.
fields.middle_text:
IFOAM – Organics International (an organization that promotes organic farming) says, “Organic Agriculture is a production of a system that sustains the health of soils, ecosystems, and people. It relies on ecological processes, biodiversity and cycles adapted to local conditions, rather than the use of inputs with adverse effects. Organic Agriculture combines tradition, innovation, and science to benefit the shared environment and promote fair relationships and good quality of life for all involved.”

Therefore, we strictly stand against synthetic products. Since we are into the business of supplying medicinal plants, we took the organic route to cultivate these herbs. With the help of our well-experienced R&D team, we have embraced an environment-friendly method of agronomy which uses organic supplementation instead of chemical fertilization. Our farmers also follow the Good Agricultural Practices (GAP) instituted by the Food and Agricultural Organization of the United Nations (FAO).

The use of natural products as a source of a compound in drug discovery is gaining momentum. Synthetic drugs address the symptoms of a disease, but natural drugs augment the body’s own healing system.
​
Our process of extracting the raw materials from plant source adheres to certified standards. We inspect random samples of raw materials before every production cycle. This guarantees the production of crème de la crème of herbal extracts.

fields.hero_subtitle: Giving back to the community and nurturing the environment for a sustainable future.
fields.intro_content:
Our global CR policy focuses on four key areas where we believe we can make the most difference.

For three of these – Industry, Environment and People – we have established a global framework for our operating companies to work within, allowing them flexibility over which area to invest in according to what will have the most meaning and impact locally.

Whilst local legal standards apply as an absolute minimum, we aim to achieve good practice in our local markets and share this across the Group. The fourth area – Community – is entirely locally driven, allowing our people to support causes close to them and to become involved in their communities.
fields.pillar_1_content: We aim to leverage the unique relationships that we have with our customers across the globe to continue to understand and support the issues and challenges that they face.
fields.pillar_2_content: We continue to analyse our impact on our environment. We remain committed to reducing our energy consumption and related emissions where possible, as well as reducing our wider impacts such as resource use and waste to landfill.
fields.pillar_3_content: We have a Code of Ethics which recognizes the importance of treating all of our employees fairly, covering issues such as responsible employment, diversity and equal opportunities. This is an effective way of communicating, at a high level, the principles which should be applied in the conduct of our business.
fields.pillar_4_content: Our local communities are important to us. We support a number of charities and community organisations worldwide in order to make a positive impact on the communities where we have a presence.
fields.pillar_5_content: As a part of corporate social responsibility, we at Biomed Ingredients has started a program called the “Green Initiative”. We care for the mother nature and with this initiative, we are involving each and every human being directly or indirectly in saving our planet.

fields.quality_text_1:
Quality at Bio Med Ingredients is guided by a structured, science-led framework. It is upheld through disciplined sourcing, controlled manufacturing systems and evidence-based evaluation. Our focus is to ensure that every ingredient we supply meets defined standards of identity, purity and performance.

We work with trusted cultivation and raw material partners who follow responsible agricultural and post-harvest practices. All incoming materials undergo authentication and verification before processing, ensuring consistency and traceability from the point of origin.
fields.quality_text_2:
Our manufacturing operations are supported by a DSIR Recognised R and D Unit, equipped to conduct analytical validation, formulation studies and continuous process improvement. The R and D unit works closely with production and quality teams to enhance extraction efficiency, maintain fingerprint consistency and reinforce product stability. This scientific foundation strengthens reliability across our supply chain.

Production is carried out in controlled environments with standardised operating procedures and monitored processing lines. Quality assessment includes raw material evaluation, in-process checks and final product testing using validated analytical methods. Parameters covered include identity, purity, microbial safety, heavy metal limits and pesticide residue compliance, aligned with globally accepted regulatory expectations.
fields.quality_text_3:
Documentation, batch traceability and specification transparency form a critical part of our quality assurance system. We maintain readiness for regulatory review and partner audits, reinforcing confidence in every supply.

For Bio Med Ingredients, quality is not an isolated function. It is an organisational discipline supported by trained teams, scientific capability and operational integrity. It is the standard we commit to consistently and the promise we uphold in every partnership.

fields.name: SerattaPure™
fields.description: Preclinical studies confirm 2.37× higher bioavailability than reference standard, with peak absorption at 1-hour post-dose.
fields.detailed_description: SerattaPure™ is the Boswellia Serrata extract standardised to 20% Boswellic acid content and formulated to enhance the bioavailability of the Boswellic acid. This product has been tested in Rats. The comparison studies are evident that SerattaPure™ has 2.37 times higher bioavailability than the reference standard. Also, in this study it is shown that the maximum absorption happens in the timeline of 1 hr after feeding the drug. Pre -Clinical studies are completed and results obtained are graphically represented below.
fields.mechanism:
Acetyl-11-keto--boswellic acid (AKBA) is a compound in Boswellia serrata that can increase free
cytoplasmic calcium levels in human polymorphonuclear leukocyte (PMNL) cells. This increase may be due to
endoplasmic reticulum leakage. Hence AKBA may be beneficial against bone loss during osteoporosis.
fields.preclinical_studies: Pre-clinical studies were conducted for SerattaPure™ manufactured, formulated and marketed by Bio-Med Ingredients Pvt. Ltd with regular Marketed Boswellia Serrata Extract 65%. The objective of this study is to evaluate the Comparative Pharmacokinetic Study of SerattaPure™ with Boswellia Serrata Extract 65% in Sprague Dawley Rats by Oral Route. Based on the results obtained in the present study conditions, it can be concluded that the maximum absorption of SerattaPure™ has 2.37 times higher bioavailability than the reference standard and the maximum absorption happens in the timeline of 1 hr after administration of the drug.

fields.detailed_description: CurcuminAura™ is our turmeric extract standardised to 60% curcuminoids content and formulated to enhance the bioavailability of the curcuminoids. We compared the regular curcuminoids 95% with CurcuminAura™ (60% Curcuminoids) which has shown 3.8 times higher bioavailability than the regular curcuminoids 95%.
fields.mechanism: Curcumin, the active compound in turmeric, has poor bioavailability due to its low solubility in water, Poor absorption, Rapid metabolism, and quick systemic elimination making it difficult to absorb in the aqueous environment of the body. By incorporating Curcumin into phospholipid complexes, it becomes more readily dissolved and absorbed.

fields.name: Forskolix™
fields.description: Standardized from Coleus forskohlii roots for metabolic, cardiovascular, and respiratory applications.
fields.applications: Weight management, blood pressure support, respiratory/asthma wellness, eye care.
fields.health_benefits: Anti-diabetic, Weight management, helps in the treatment of Congestive heart function, treatment of hypertrophic cardiomyopathy.
fields.detailed_description:
Forskolix™ is extracted and standardised by Coleus forskolin roots. Coleus forskohlii, a plant used in traditional medicine, contains a compound called Forskolin, which is thought
to have various effects on metabolism and glucose regulation. Forskolin has an efficacy of lowering blood pressure, improving blood circulation and heart function and helps in reducing respiratory tract infections, cough and restlessness. Also, Forskolin is used in stinging of the eyes and enlarging of blood vessels in the eyes. Coleus extract improved insulin sensitivity in people with Type 2 diabetes.
fields.mechanism: Activation of Adenylyl Cyclase (cAMP Pathway): Forskolin activates an enzyme called adenylyl cyclase, which increases levels of cyclic AMP (cAMP) in cells. This can have several effects, including promoting the activity of protein kinase A (PKA), which influences various metabolic processes, including glucose metabolism and modulates various cardiovascular functions. Insulin Sensitivity: Some studies suggest that forskolin may help increase insulin sensitivity by improving the function of insulin receptors and the effectiveness of insulin signalling. This could potentially help reduce insulin resistance, a key factor in type 2 diabetes. Increased Lipolysis: Forskolin may also promote the breakdown of fats (lipolysis), which could help improve insulin sensitivity. When fat cells are reduced or more efficiently utilized, insulin becomes more effective in regulating blood sugar levels.

The objective of this study is to evaluate the efficacy of Forskolix™ in Streptozotocin induced diabetes in Sprague Dawley Rats when administered by Oral route. The animals were kept for overnight fasting for approximately 14-16 hours. The streptozotocin (60 mg/kg IP) was injected by intraperitoneal route as a single dose on day 1 to induce diabetes. Animals will be screened for development of hyperglycaemia (fasting blood glucose >250 mg/kg) for 5 days after streptozotocin injection. fields.description: A multi-botanical formulation combining fenugreek saponins with Jamun seed extract and Oxalis polyphenols for blood glucose management and immune support.
fields.applications: Diabetes management, blood sugar control, immunity.
fields.detailed_description: FenuraBlend™ is a formulated product which has Fenugreek saponins and other polyphenols derived from Amla extract and Jamun seed extract, that is specially formulated to treat Diabetes. Also, this product is loaded with essential nutrients to increase the efficacy of the product. This product helps in reducing blood sugar level & also works as an Immunity booster.
fields.mechanism: Fenugreek extract helps in managing blood sugar levels as the soluble fibres and alkaloids in fenugreek help to improve insulin sensitivity. Also, Jamun seed extract can regulate blood sugar levels as it has the ability to reduce glucose absorption and improve insulin function. Combining both these ingredients together, it can be a powerful medium for blood sugar regulation. Fenugreek contains compounds that may inhibit alpha-amylase, an enzyme responsible for breaking down carbohydrates into sugar. By inhibiting this enzyme, Fenugreek can reduce the rate at which carbohydrates are converted into glucose, leading to lower blood sugar levels after meals. Also, Fenugreek may help enhance the uptake of glucose into cells, particularly muscle cells, where it can be used for energy. Fenugreek has been found to lower postprandial (after meal) blood sugar levels. This effect is likely related to the high fiber content and its ability to slow the absorption of glucose from the digestive tract.

It has an efficacy of reduction of insulin resistance, anti inflammatory effects and also enhances the bioavailability of any active ingredients. Pre-Clinical and Clinical studies under trial. Application : Enhancing the absorption of the active ingredients. This ingredient should be used along with any other nutraceutical ingredient, hence it increases the absorption and efficiency of the active ingredients.
fields.mechanism: Bioavailability Enhancer: Piperine binds with the active ingredient and works as drug delivery system. Hence the more absorption and efficiency of ingredient will be increased.Piperine is well-known for enhancing the bioavailability of various drugs and nutrients. It achieves this by inhibiting certain enzymes in the liver (such as cytochrome P450 enzymes) and the intestinal wall, which typically metabolize drugs or nutrients, reducing their absorption. By inhibiting these enzymes, piperine can increase the absorption of other compounds, such as curcumin (from turmeric) and certain vitamins and minerals, making them more effective.
fields.preclinical_studies: Black pepper, often called the "king of spices," offers a range of potential health benefits beyond its flavor-enhancing properties. Many of these benefits are attributed to piperine, its main bioactive compound.
